rows.title: The germinal identification page counts packages in its selected commodities summary
rows.detail: A germinal consignment is counted in packages, not in head of animals, so the summary of chosen commodities at the top of the germinal products set's identification page must say so. The page lists each chosen species with the number of packages the trader saved against it, while the live animals set's identification page keeps counting animals. A trader checking what they are about to identify then reads the same unit they were asked for on commodity details.
acceptanceCriteria: The germinal products set's identification page heads the 'Selected commodities' quantity column 'Number of packages' and shows each chosen species' saved number of packages, while the live animals set's identification page heads that column 'Number of animals'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-036; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-067; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023, -p1-110)
rows.notes: A thin slice, not a row to keep alone: it is observable only once the germinal products set has an identification page, and that page is built by the germinal-products area's row for it. Combiner: these requirements already sit in inc-052 with that area's rows for the same page and the notification-record area's backend storage, so merge this draft into inc-052, keeping its id, its germinal-products theme, its repos (backend stays for the storage half) and its dependencies, and merge this criterion with the ones already there. The one criterion names both sets' headings in one sentence because the requirement is the contrast: germinal counts packages where live animals count animals. The live animals column is unchanged, so this row changes no live animals code; the germinal page is copied from the live one after that page is built, which is why inc-052 waits on the identification-and-permanent-address theme's row for it. Carried over from the earlier draft of this row unchanged: no later ruling has moved the packages column.

rows.title: Germinal collection and production dates: a text field with a 'Choose date' calendar, and the identification page's format, real-date and length checks
rows.detail: Germinal products are identified by a donor, two dates and an identification mark. Each of the two dates is asked as a text field a calendar enhances, so a trader can either type the date or pick it from a month grid, and the field still works when the browser has no JavaScript. Nothing bounds either date: any real date, past or future, is accepted, and the production date is never compared with the collection date. A date given in the wrong form, a date in the right form that is not a real calendar date, and an identification mark that is too long are each refused with their own message, shown in the error summary and on the field, so the trader can see which answer to put right.
acceptanceCriteria: On the germinal products set's identification page, 'Collection date' and 'Production date' are each a single text field with the hint 'For example, 27/03/2026'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-022, -p5-023; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p4-021; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-066, -p12-068)

Each of those two fields has a 'Choose date' button that opens a month calendar with buttons to move to the previous and next month and year, and 'Select' and 'Close'; picking a day fills that field's text box with the day, month and four-digit year. (ruling:interaction-designer-2026-11-09 ruling-interaction-designer-2026-11-09-p1-014, -p1-039, -p1-040, -p1-042; ruling:sam-2026-11-10 ruling-sam-2026-11-10-p1-010, -p1-011, -p1-012)

With JavaScript unavailable, each of those two fields behaves as a plain text field: a trader types the date, saves it, and it reads back exactly as typed. (ruling:interaction-designer-2026-11-09 ruling-interaction-designer-2026-11-09-p1-048; ruling:sam-2026-11-10 ruling-sam-2026-11-10-p1-012)

A collection date in the past, a collection date in the future, a production date in the past, a production date in the future and a production date earlier than the collection date all save with no error and read back exactly as entered. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-031)
A 'Collection date' of 1/9/2026 saves with no error and reads back as entered, so a one-digit day and month are accepted. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-029)

An 'Identification number/mark' of 59 characters shows 'Identification number/mark must be 58 characters or less' in the error summary and inline on the field, and one of 58 characters saves. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-028)
A 'Collection date' of 2026-09-01 shows 'Enter a collection date in the format DD/MM/YYYY' in the error summary and inline on the field. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-029)
A 'Production date' of 2026-09-01 shows 'Enter a production date in the format DD/MM/YYYY' in the error summary and inline on the field. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-029)
A 'Collection date' of 99/99/2026 shows 'Collection date must be a real date' in the error summary and inline on the field. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-030)
A 'Production date' of 31/02/2026 shows 'Production date must be a real date' in the error summary and inline on the field. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-030)
notes: Combines six thin slices that change the same two fields on the same page: the fields themselves and their calendar, the leniency rules, and the four messages. Building them apart would repeat the germinal page set-up, the review and the whole verification ladder for one validator each.

Combiner: these requirements already sit in inc-053 with the germinal-products area's sibling requirements for the same page and fields (the donor length, the date leniency and the error order), so merge this draft into inc-053, keeping its id, its germinal-products theme, its repos and its dependency on the row that builds the germinal identification page, and merge these criteria with the ones already there. Several of the criteria already on inc-053 are the cross-area pass's restatements of these same requirements, so one criterion each covers both.

The calendar is the house date picker every other date in both frontends already uses, built through the shared date-picker field helper in the frontend's shared kit, not a new component and not a three-part day/month/year input. Its styling belongs to the design-snagging theme, so this row uses the helper and changes no shared styling; the ruling folded the calendar into this row rather than leaving it a design question.
The hint 'For example, 27/03/2026' is the germinal wording in the target design; the service's other date hints read '27/3/2026', so the two differ on purpose.
Both dates are saved as entered, so this slice needs no record change beyond the storage the germinal identification page row lands.
Observable only once the germinal products set's identification page exists, which the germinal-products area's row for that page builds, so this slice lands after it.
